m3gb.summary: M3GB ran exactly one human-approved retained-worker training command plus one evaluator command, copied back the output, stopped the worker, preserved fail-closed claim surfaces, and selected local metric triage.

absent_or_joined_fields: No full class probability vector is present.
Non-predicted true-label confidence for incorrect rows is not present.
Tensor paths are not present in the sidecar; this receipt joined them read-only from existing manifests by clip_id.

confidence_and_threshold_patterns.finding: The selected 0.49 threshold limits false passes, but it only accepts 3 validation rows and 1 test row. Calibration therefore does not rescue held-out recognition or justify promotion.

signer_source_split_tensor_patterns.source_record_pattern: No repeated source_record_id cluster is visible among validation/test examples; every focus-row error listed below has a distinct source record.
signer_source_split_tensor_patterns.source_scope_pattern: All validation/test evidence is from the same approved ASL Citizen school-assignment raw-video source, so this receipt cannot separate source-family quality from label/signer/split effects.
signer_source_split_tensor_patterns.tensor_path_pattern: Joined tensor paths are unique per focus-row error. All inspected manifest examples use the same rgb_regions_grid_v1 shape [16, 5, 96, 96, 3], so no tensor-shape cluster is visible.
signer_source_split_tensor_patterns.split_pattern: The test split is weaker than validation: validation has 17/27 errors and two zero-recall labels; test has 21/28 errors and four zero-recall labels. Test errors concentrate around sad predictions and low/medium confidence rather than threshold-pass false accepts.

notes: Rows cover every incorrect black, please, table, and white validation/test example visible in the sidecar.
true_label_confidence is null for incorrect rows because the sidecar does not include non-predicted class probabilities.
tensor_path values are joined read-only from existing manifests; no raw video or tensor artifact was opened or generated.

comparison_to_m3fy_and_m3gc.m3fy_table_weakness: M3FY found an asymmetric table weakness in a two-label proof: table recall 0.5 while hello recall was 1.0, with two table false negatives predicted as hello at very high confidence.
comparison_to_m3fy_and_m3gc.m3gb_comparison: M3GB did not resolve table weakness. Table recall fell to 0.0 on validation and test. Black also had 0.0 recall on both splits, and please/white were 0.0 recall on test.
comparison_to_m3fy_and_m3gc.m3gc_metric_triage: M3GC already showed the aggregate gate failure and low-coverage threshold. M3GD adds per-example signer/source/tensor/confidence accounting and shows the remaining evidence is underpowered for a single root-cause repair.

evidence_for: Black and table are zero-recall on validation and test.
Please and white become zero-recall on test.
Validation errors overpredict uncle and hello; test errors overpredict sad.
Selected threshold accepts too few rows to recover useful coverage.
evidence_against_or_limits: The sidecar lacks full class probability vectors, so true-label confidence for incorrect rows is unknown.
A label-bias explanation does not identify whether the cause is data, crop, temporal features, architecture, or split construction.

evidence_for: Validation low performers are P39 at 1/6 and P26 at 2/8.
Test has zero-correct signer P17 at 0/4 and weak signers P49 at 1/7 and P6 at 1/6.
Validation and test splits differ materially in zero-recall labels and dominant wrong predictions.
evidence_against_or_limits: All source records are unique and from the same approved source family.
Current receipts do not prove signer, source, split, or row-order causality.

evidence_for: Table remains weak after M3FY and M3GB.
Black/table/please/white failures could reflect missing hand/contact or context cues in fixed regions.
evidence_against_or_limits: All joined examples share the same rgb_regions_grid_v1 tensor shape.
No raw video, crop thumbnails, or per-region quality fields were inspected or generated in this mission.
A crop/input change would require a separate approved contract.

evidence_for: Training moved but held-out transfer stayed weak.
Validation peaked early at epoch 5 and worsened by epoch 12.
M3FW previously fit train rows but failed the held-out dominant-class gate.
evidence_against_or_limits: Existing sidecar/report rows cannot distinguish motion representation from source/split/crop effects.
Best validation was epoch 5 at 0.37037037037037035 and later validation loss worsened.
Test top-1 stayed 0.25 with four zero-recall labels.
Another compute action is not justified without a fresh receipt proposal and human approval.

what_remains_unproven: Whether signer identity, source capture, split construction, crop coverage, temporal motion, architecture/objective, or budget is the dominant root cause.
Whether black/table failures share a visual/crop issue, a class-boundary issue, or a source/split issue.
Whether full probability vectors would reveal true-label near-misses beyond top2 fields.
Whether future crop/Detector 0 proxy work would improve held-out transfer.
